title: Web Clips
description: Puts a website shortcut on the Home Screen (iOS) or in the Dock (macOS).

FullScreen.title: Open full screen
FullScreen.description: On opens the page as a full-screen web app without Safari controls.

Icon.title: Icon
Icon.description: Square PNG, up to 400 x 400 pixels. A white square is used if empty.

IgnoreManifestScope.title: Stay full screen on other sites
IgnoreManifestScope.description: On keeps full-screen mode when leaving the clip's site. iOS 14+.

IsRemovable.title: Allow removing
IsRemovable.description: Off stops the user deleting the web clip.

Label.title: Label
Label.description: Name shown under the icon on the Home Screen.

Precomposed.title: Use icon as is
Precomposed.description: On stops the system adding effects to the icon.

TargetApplicationBundleIdentifier.title: Open in app (bundle ID)
TargetApplicationBundleIdentifier.description: Bundle ID of the app that opens the URL instead of Safari. iOS 14+.

URL.title: URL
URL.description: The web address the clip opens.
